offsets.description: Offsets for subordinate stations relative to a reference station

reference.description: The ID of the reference station

height.description: Defines the values to add or multiply with water levels (depending on type)

high.description: Height offset/multiplier for high tide - if type is 'ratio', this is a multiplier; if 'fixed', this is an offset to add (can be negative)

low.description: Height offset/multiplier for low tide - if type is 'ratio', this is a multiplier; if 'fixed', this is an offset to add (can be negative)

time.description: Defines the time to add to when a high or low tide will occur

high.description: Time offset, in minutes, to add to the high tide (can be negative)

low.description: Time offset, in minutes, to add to the low tide (can be negative)

id.description: Unique station ID for this database only, in the format of `source/id`.

continent.description: Continent name in title case (e.g., `North America`, `Asia`, `Europe`)

country_code.description: Stable ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country identity, independent of display name

region.description: ISO 3166-2 region code, if available. If not, whatever local postal codes

disclaimers.description: Any disclaimers about using this data

id.description: The identifier used by the source for this station.

published_harmonics.description: Are the harmonics from published harmonic data? False means harmonics were computed.

url.description: URL to this station's data or information in the source's website

stillwell.description: For a fit of a Stillwell series (sources/stillwell): what it was fitted from, how, and how it scored. Kept in the data file only; the database doesn't carry it.

inputs.description: What the fit read: each year file's version by `<epoch> <year>`, the station's epochs and QC start, the errata in the years read, the decisions on kept ones, and for a source that doesn't finalize, the settle cutoff.

final.description: `verified`: the source's verified values, and preliminary ones from before its QC start. `settled`: measured values from before this project's settle cutoff, for a source that never marks values final.

engine.description: The @slackwater/engine version the fit ran on.

selection.description: Every candidate, in priority order: kept, or the engine's reason not (rayleigh, snr, rankDeficient, nyquist, unknown).

constituents.description: Each fitted constituent's 95% amplitude and phase intervals and SNR, unrounded.

yearly.description: Year-to-year scatter of M2, S2, K1 and O1, and of Sa and Ssa.

seasonal.description: Sa and Ssa: the whole window's fit, the spread of the yearly fits, and whether they publish (amplitude at least twice the standard error of the yearly mean).

rms.description: The fit's tidal-band residual RMS on the held-out year, in metres.

ticon.description: By TICON id, the scores of the TICON records Stillwell matched to this series by levels.

rms.description: This TICON record's tidal-band residual RMS on the held-out year, in metres.

se.description: Standard error, in m², of the fit's residual variance minus this record's, from 30-day blocks; null where the year has too few to measure it.

digest.description: constituentsDigest of this record's constants as scored. A score counts only while it still matches.

seen.description: Whether this record's analysis covered the held-out year.

links.description: Every TICON record Stillwell links this series to, by TICON id.

additionalProperties.description: Stillwell's comparison of this series' hourly levels with the TICON record's GESLA series (stations/matches.parquet), or null where Stillwell has none.

license.description: Defines the license and whatever restrictions are placed on use of the data.

type.description: A short description of the type of license (i.e. MIT, public domain, etc)

commercial_use.description: If `true` then there are no restrictions on commercial use.

url.description: A URL to the license information

notes.description: Any additional restrictions or information on the license.

name.description: Harmonic Constituent code (i.e. M2) - should be upper-case

datums_source.description: Mean-datum method: 'observed' from prepared water-level measurements, or 'harmonic' synthesized from constituents. Other datum keys can use different methods.

datum_frame.description: Zero of the stored datum values: the observation gauge zero, or the harmonic constituent frame without a supported gauge offset. Absence means unspecified; neither value identifies a geodetic datum.

datum_coverage.description: Measured and model-assisted hourly bins in the observed mean-datum reduction period. Absence means unspecified, not zero inference.

chart_datum.description: The chart datum key used as the vertical reference for this station (e.g., MLLW, LAT). Must match a key in the datums object.

epoch.description: Source-reported analysis or datum period; TICON uses its constituent fit period.

start.description: Start date of the source analysis or datum period (YYYY-MM-DD format)

end.description: End date of the source analysis or datum period (YYYY-MM-DD format)

datum_epoch.description: Mean-datum reduction period, separate from the constituent fit period.

start.description: Start date of the mean-datum reduction period (YYYY-MM-DD format)

end.description: End date of the mean-datum reduction period (YYYY-MM-DD format)
